title: Rendu
desc: Sakthi moves to the city in search of a job. However, he lands in trouble when a CBI officer mistakes him for a serial killer who is his doppelgänger.

title: Michael Madana Kama Rajan
desc: A wicked man separates a set of quadruplets after their birth, while one of them ends up with their biological father, the other three find new homes. However, chaos ensues when they cross paths.

title: Iru Kodugal
desc: When his family disapproves of his wife, he deserts her and starts anew. However, his first wife ends up being the boss at his new job, leaving him reeling.

title: Thotta Chinungi
desc: Gopal does not like that his wife, Bhuvana, is friends with Mano and gets suspicious about her. However, he realizes his mistake and makes amends.

title: Dham
desc: After Rushi changes his violent ways and helps four college friends resolve their problems, they decide to repay his kindness by reuniting him with his former girlfriend.
